431:t_2:17.en:
$$レド$$
「But when I ended up fighting him... I was seized by an unaccountable unease...」

431:t_2:18.en:
$$レド$$
「That feeling... It was the same one I had when I turned against Lieutenant Colonel $$クーゲル$$.」

431:t_2:19.en:
$$タケル$$
「Lieutenant Colonel $$クーゲル$$... He was your superior in the $$人類銀河同盟$$, right, $$レド$$?」

431:t_2:20.en:
$$万丈$$
「The feeling of fighting something like that... I think I understand it.」

431:t_2:21.en:
$$桂$$
「Guilt, a sense of betrayal, self-denial... Emotions I couldn't make sense of welled up from somewhere.」

431:t_2:22.en:
$$ノリコ$$
「That feeling, as if I were the one in the wrong...」

431:t_2:23.en:
$$アムロ$$
「Maybe that is exactly $$アドヴェント#pilot$$'s power... Something like a $$スフィア・アクト$$, perhaps.」

431:t_2:24.en:
$$バナージ$$
「$$スフィア・アクト$$...」

431:t_2:25.en:
$$赤木$$
「Hey, $$クロウ$$... Is $$アドヴェント#pilot$$ a $$スフィア・リアクター$$ too?」

431:t_2:26.en:
$$クロウ$$
「We talked about that among ourselves, and we actually asked $$アドヴェント#pilot$$ himself, too.」

431:t_2:28.en:
$$ランド$$
「In the end he just brushed us off, so we never got a clear answer.」

431:t_2:29.en:
$$セツコ$$
「But it's certain that $$アドヴェント#pilot$$'s unit was using $$次元力$$.」

431:t_2:30.en:
$$刹那$$
「That $$アスクレプス$$ was destroyed, but...」

431:t_2:31.en:
$$正太郎$$
「But he took down $$ジェニオン・ガイ$$ with nothing but his own body.」

431:t_2:32.en:
$$ワッ太$$
「He was just like 《$$ガイオウ$$》!」

431:t_2:33.en:
$$ロジャー$$
「At the very least, he is not human...」

431:t_2:34.en:
$$バナージ$$
「Also, he called himself a $$テンシ$$.」

431:t_2:35.en:
$$赤木$$
「Did he cause the $$時空震動$$ and take the lives of $n's dad and sister!?」

431:t_2:36.en:
$$アムロ$$
「...I don't know. None of it makes sense.」

431:t_2:37.en:
$$レド$$
「Is he going to make us his targets from now on?」

431:t_2:38.en:
$$刹那$$
「Unknown. To begin with, I can't make sense of the $$クロノ$$ Reformists' actions at all.」

431:t_2:39.en:
$$赤木$$
「That sudden change of heart... Does it mean they were using us for their own goals and now they're done with us?」

431:t_2:40.en:
$$隼人$$
「That can't be it. If their enemy is the $$サイデリアル$$, they gain nothing at all by cutting us off here.」

431:t_2:41.en:
$$隼人$$
「Random behavior... It's almost like they're acting on a whim...」

431:t_2:42.en:
$$桂$$
「There's just too much I don't understand. I give up.」

431:t_2:43.en:
$$竜馬$$
「Damn it... We finally liberated $$翠の地球$$, and now I end up feeling like this...!」

431:t_2:45.en:
$$宗介$$
「He is asleep in the $$プトレマイオス$$ infirmary.」

431:t_2:47.en:
$$甲児$$
「All that training paid off. Physically it's just bruises and a few cuts, and they say his life isn't in danger...」

431:t_2:48.en:
$$宗介$$
「But he still hasn't regained consciousness...」

431:t_2:50.en:
$$甲児$$
「The $$アドヴェント#pilot$$ he trusted turned out to be the very $$テンシ$$ he was chasing, and Nurse was with that guy, too...」

431:t_2:51.en:
$$タケル$$
「Miss $$スズネ$$, the $$ジェニオン$$... He's been hit by one huge shock after another...」

431:t_2:52.en:
$$バナージ$$
「But $n will be all right, won't he...!?」

431:t_2:54.en:
$$バナージ$$
「Up to now, $n has overcome one wall after another, hasn't he!」

431:t_2:56.en:
$$ランド$$
「All we can do is believe in $n.」

431:t_2:57.en:
$$万丈$$
「But we don't have time to wait for his recovery. We'll be heading to $$蒼の地球$$ right away.」

431:t_2:58.en:
$$アムロ$$
「$$オペレーション・エクリプス$$... The full-scale counteroffensive against the $$新地球皇国$$ is about to begin...」

431:t_2:59.en:
$$甲児$$
($n... Are you really going to end here...?)

431:t_2:60.en:
$$宗介$$
(The $$テンシ$$, your enemy, has been found. All that's left is for you to fight...)

431:t_2:66.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「...Repairs on the $$ジェニオン$$ are now on track.」

431:t_2:67.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「All that's left is to wait for $n to wake up. Please, wake up.」

431:t_2:70.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Then, in accordance with the contract, I shall take action as well.」

431:t_10:4.en:
$$高性能ＡＩ$$
「Welcome. As shop owner $$ＡＧ$$ is absent today, we will be running the $$Ｄトレーダー$$ under our caretaker service.」

431:t_10:5.en:
$$高性能ＡＩ$$
「Furthermore, as for the congratulations to ace pilots, we ask your understanding that they will be held on another occasion.」

431:t_10:6.en:
$$高性能ＡＩ$$
「Now then, everyone, please take your time and enjoy your shopping.」

432:t_000:0.en:
$$メラン$$
「The $$セントラル・ベース$$ assault force has sortied.」

432:t_000:1.en:
$$ブライト$$
「So we've somehow made it this far.」

432:t_001:0.en:
$$シモン$$
「They're swarming out of the woodwork!」

432:t_001:1.en:
$$サルディアス$$
「Well, honestly, I hadn't intended to use this force at all.」

432:t_001:2.en:
$$カトル$$
「True, from breaking through the defense line to reaching this base, we struggled through one battle after another.」

432:t_001:3.en:
$$トロワ$$
「Thanks to all the traps you prepared for us.」

432:t_001:4.en:
$$サルディアス$$
「Goodness... I never thought you'd break through every last one.」

432:t_001:5.en:
$$ティエリア$$
「Attacks by mind-controlled resistance fighters... Captured civilians used as human shields...」

432:t_001:6.en:
$$コーラサワー$$
「Hallucination attacks that stir up trauma, and assassination squads sent to our camps...」

432:t_001:7.en:
$$グラハム$$
「Every one of them was a despicable trick that made me sick!」

432:t_001:8.en:
$$サルディアス$$
「There's no 'dirty' or 'schmirty' in war. That... is galactic common sense.」

432:t_001:9.en:
$$ゼクス$$
「I have no intention of exchanging tactical theories with you.」

432:t_001:10.en:
$$サルディアス$$
「Of course. I feel the same.」

432:t_001:11.en:
$$サルディアス$$
「If I dawdle too much, I'll end up like $$ギルター$$.」

432:t_001:12.en:
$$勝平$$
「Hey, old man! Where's Sis $$セツコ$$!?」

432:t_001:13.en:
$$サルディアス$$
「Don't you worry. $$セツコ$$ is in that base.」

432:t_001:14.en:
$$サルディアス$$
「Our boss has her in safekeeping, with the greatest of care.」

432:t_001:16.en:
$$ランド$$
「Don't fall for it, $$シン$$! Riling us up like that is that bastard's specialty!」

432:t_001:17.en:
$$サルディアス$$
「It really is awkward to work when there are familiar faces around.」

432:t_001:18.en:
$$クロウ$$
「Let's end this farce, $$サルディアス$$. Scratch the surface and you're the same as $$バルビエル$$ - you think human lives are no better than bugs, don't you.」

432:t_001:19.en:
$$サルディアス$$
「I won't deny it.」

432:t_001:20.en:
$$サルディアス$$
「For the record, I do know the saying 'Even the smallest bug has its spirit'...」

432:t_001:21.en:
$$アマタ$$
「We don't need to hold back against someone like that!」

kept_omissions: 431:t_2:20: 'the feeling of fighting that' - object left unspecific ('something like that'); scene (Ledo's dread of Advent) implies it but not certain
431:t_2:37: 奴 = Advent inferred from the preceding scene ('he')
431:t_2:50: 自分 = $n (Hibiki), あいつ = Advent; rendered 'he'/'that guy'
uncertain: 432:t_001:8: 卑怯もラッキョウもありません is a rhyming pun; rendered "no 'dirty' or 'schmirty'"
431:t_2:50: ナースさん rendered plain 'Nurse' per settled rule; not sure who the Nurse is
431:t_2:20: Banjo's それと戦う感覚 - referent of それ unclear
431:t_2:34: テンシ rendered with the keyword token $$テンシ$$ (Tenshi), not 'angel'
431:t_2:38 etc.: クロノ改革派 = '$$クロノ$$ Reformists' as in earlier slices (no glossary entry)
431:t_10:4-6: high-performance AI's katakana-only speech rendered in plain English
432:t_001:14/15: 保管 rendered 'safekeeping' so Shin's echo works
431:t_2:44: 「…$nは？」 rendered 'What about $n?' (could be 'Where is'); Sousuke answers where he is
